corpus.text: Customers may request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Submit refund requests through the account billing page. Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method.
Customer support is available Monday to Friday. Online technical support is provided through the customer portal.
Never share your password. Enable two-factor authentication to add extra protection to your account.
Only upload documents you have permission to use. Do not upload confidential or sensitive information unless you are authorized to process it.
Physical orders are dispatched within two business days. Customers receive a tracking link after dispatch.
Customers can find their invoices in the account billing dashboard. Downloadable invoices include the purchase date and order reference.
Customers may cancel a subscription any time before its next renewal date. Access remains active until the current billing period ends.
The application supports PDF and DOCX documents. Image-only scanned PDFs may need optical character recognition before their text can be searched.
